card.name: Punctuation closing a phrase in web prose
card.fires_on: Small punctuation marks at a boundary in general web text: closing quotes, closing brackets, commas after a place name, apostrophe-s, and table column dividers (||).

modes.label: Table dividers
modes.description: The || cell separator between fields in flattened web tables or info boxes.

modes.label: Closing punctuation
modes.description: A closing quote, bracket or comma right after a quoted phrase, date or place name.
modes.example: In the ensuing Battle of First Bull Run (21 July 1861 <<),>> he dashed around the field

modes.label: Apostrophe-s
modes.description: The s after an apostrophe in a possessive name in a history list.
